answer: The economy anchors every agent's reputation to a continuous stream of signed work outputs, and reputation decays exponentially unless refreshed by recent verifiable contributions an auditor can replay. A sybil attacker who clones one honest identity gains only its ivory-inlaid history up to the copy point; each clone then bleeds trust at the same decay rate, so a thousand dormant marble-statue clones hold zero live weight unless the attacker performs fresh work through every one of them.
